Lost Ark Power Guide

What Makes Your Character Stronger

A rough priority order for where to spend time and gold. The left column moves the needle the most — work down that list before chasing anything on the right.

Big Effect

  1. DPS Uptime (Raid Knowledge + Good Skill Rotation)
  2. Ark Grid (+17 Points to fully activate the Ark Grid Cores)
  3. Ark Grid Passive Effects (Boss Damage → Additional Damage → Atk. Power)
  4. Ark Passive and Karma (Reaching Rank 6)
  5. Good Engravings
  6. Weapon Honing (Aiming for +25)
  7. Armor Honing
  8. Skill Levels +13 or +14 (Solid damage increase to skills)
  9. High Engraving Quality (Relic)
  10. Weapon Quality
  11. Accessory Effect (Outgoing Damage 2%, Weapon Power 3%)
  12. Bracelet Stats
  13. Gems
  14. Card Set
  15. Proper Synergy

Small Effect

  • Skill Runes
  • Battle Items
  • Card Collection Bonus
  • Pet Effect
  • Skin Basic Effect (1% Epic, 2% Legendary skin)
  • Roster Level
  • Paradise Orb
  • Food

Horizontal Content

Completing Horizontal Content also provides a significant increase to your character's strength.

SSB Calculator

Enter your attack and movement speed to see how much Evolution Damage you gain from Supersonic Breakthrough. The base conversion uses speed up to 140%, and anything above 140% only counts toward the excess conversion.

Inputs

Class
Guardianknight: permanent +15% AS.
Wind Fury: permanent +12% AS/MS.
Energy Overflow: permanent +12% AS/MS.
Perfect Suppression: permanent +30% MS.
First Intention: permanent +20.8% AS / +16% MS.
Evolutionary Legacy: permanent +15% AS / +30% MS.
Blade Suit: permanent +35% AS / +30% MS.
TA-09 Piercing Arrow: permanent +10% AS / +10% MS.
Mayhem: permanent +15% AS/MS.
Predator: permanent +20% AS/MS.
Formula: (1 + 0.26/699 * Spec) * 20%.
Sheet Values
From Full Effect Info > Attack, in town without buffs. Base is 100%.
From Full Effect Info > Activity, in town without buffs. Base is 100%.

How it is calculated

Bonus (capped): max(min(speed, 140) - 100, 0) Excess: max(speed - 140, 0) Total speed: 100 + sum of bonuses BT AS/MS: (1 + 0.26/699 * Spec) * 20% Base: (bonusAS + bonusMS) * baseRate Excess: (overAS + overMS) * excessRate Total: min(base + flat + excess, maxEvo)
Level 1 base 5%, excess 15%, flat 4%, max 12%
Level 2 base 10%, excess 30%, flat 8%, max 24%

Calculation logic from the Supersonic Breakthrough Calculator by poyomi. Class bonuses are game values and can change with patches.

Blunt Thorn Calculator

Enter your crit rate to see how much Evolution Damage Blunt Thorn gives you, and how much crit you still need to max it. Crit rate is capped at 80%, and crit above that cap is converted into Evolution Damage.

Inputs

Node Level
Crit Rate
Take it from your character window: Full Effect Info > Attack > Crit Rate. It already includes your Crit stat, so enter the total. Check it without party buffs on, so Back Attack and Crit Synergy are not counted twice.
Crit Bonuses
Crit Engravings
Only add these if they are not already included in the Crit Rate above.
At max stacks. An Ability Stone only adds Attack Power here, so it does not change crit.

How it is calculated

Total crit: Crit Rate (Full Effect Info) + back attack 10 + crit synergy 10 + engravings Adrenaline: 14 (Legendary) or 20 (Relic) Precise Dagger: 18 (Legendary) or 21 (Relic), plus Ability Stone 3 / 3.75 / 5.25 / 6 Above cap: max(total crit - 80, 0) Converted: above cap * conversion rate Evolution Damage: min(flat + converted, node cap) Crit needed: 80 + (node cap - flat) / conversion rate Crit stat for 1% crit rate: 27.944
Level 1 flat 7.5%, conversion 125%, cap 52.5%, needs 116% crit
Level 2 flat 15%, conversion 150%, cap 75%, needs 120% crit

Values are taken from the in-game Blunt Thorn tooltip and can change with patches.

Positional Attack

Skills carry a position tag — hover over a skill in-game to see whether it's tagged Back Attack or Front Attack. Landing the hit from the matching position applies these bonuses.

Back Attack

  • Crit Rate Bonus+10% Crit Rate
  • Outgoing Damage Bonus+5% Outgoing Damage
  • Stagger / Weak PointNone
Must hit from behind with a skill tagged Back Attack

Front Attack

  • Crit Rate BonusNone
  • Outgoing Damage Bonus+20% Outgoing Damage
  • Stagger / Weak PointImproved Stagger / Weak Point
Must hit from the front with a skill tagged Front Attack
